newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Goodman forms chicken j/v with OSI.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Goodman forms chicken j/v with OSI.

text.p: Australasian food group Goodman Fielder Ltd said on Thursday it had formed a joint venture with privately held U.S. chicken McNugget-maker, OSI Industries Ltd, to make cooked chicken in Australia.

Goodman Fielder Ltd chief executive David Hearn said the joint venture, with annual sales of about A$50 million, would help Goodman into the fast growing market supplying cooked chicken products to the McDonalds fast food chain.
"We are announcing today that we have formed a joint venture for the cooked foods part of the (Steggles poultry) business, a A$50 million business," Hearn said.
"We have joint ventured with a company called OSI, a very large privately held American company, who've built a very substantial business supplying McDonalds," Hearns told a news conference.

"It will further enhance our relationship with McDonalds, and importantly we think they can add something in the technology area to us and in time help us build more added value into our margins," he said.
Hearn said it would be a 50-50 joint venture based on the cooked food part of Goodman's larger Steggles poultry division, which has annual sales of about A$500 million.
The uncooked part of the division would not be part of the joint venture.
He said OSI would invest a small amount in the joint venture and provide some chicken nugget making machinery.
Goodmans already supplies all of McDonalds buns in Australia and is building a new factory to produce buns exclusively for McDonalds.
Earlier Goodmans reported a group net profit of A$28.3 million for the year to June 30 compared with a loss of A$52.8 million a year earlier.
Goodman's pre-abnormals net profit rose 3.5 percent to A$100.7 million, in line with analysts expectations of around A$100 million.
Goodman's shares were unchanged at A$1.30 at 1.05 p.m. (0305 GMT).
